reviews.title: Works but needs instructions for noobs
reviews.comment: There's no instructions. And for a noob it was confusing. Juat make sure you hook the power supply to it. But works great. Ran RDR2 using not even half capacity of the graphics card. The color was great and no lag. And for the price you cant beat it.
reviews.author: Jacob Rivas

reviews.title: Fans came w NO lights
reviews.comment: Overall the card performs well is quiet and very clean. However, my fans have absolutely 0 leds whatsoever and thats how it came 👍
reviews.author: Elijah

reviews.title: Works as should, dim leds
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1AlMXUXnLL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/717k+kx9fJL._SY256.jpg GPU works as should, though the lights in the fans are very dim. Basically every fan has 1 led that spins on the blade. And for some reason this past weekend I lost control over it after the last windows update. Kind of a waste. I would have got a different gpu if I knew I was going to have to add my own lights.
reviews.author: Beau B.
